_comment: Batch text-a (match call, union room, contests, berries, decorations, trades, credits, ribbons, follower messages). Width allowances in FONT_NORMAL px, verified against the window templates cited in each _why entry.
_why src/data/text/match_call_messages.h: pokenav_list.c PrintMatchCallFlavorText: FONT_NARROW at x=2 in the PokeNav list window (pokenav_match_call_gfx.c template.windowWidth = 16 tiles = 128px) -> 126px of FONT_NARROW. Normal-font cap = widest original line (147px normal = 126px narrow); narrow widths of every translated line separately verified <= 126px.
_why src/pokenav_match_call_data.c:*.des: pokenav_match_call_list.c BufferMatchCallNameAndDesc: desc is the first column, GetStringClearToWidth(FONT_NARROW, className, 69); list window 16 tiles (pokenav_match_call_gfx.c windowWidth=16), text at x=8. Real limit is 69px FONT_NARROW; every translated desc verified <= 66px narrow (<= 80px normal).
_why src/pokenav_match_call_data.c:*.nam: pokenav_match_call_list.c BufferMatchCallNameAndDesc: name is the second column, GetStringClearToWidth(FONT_NARROW, trainerName, 51) after the 69px desc column (8+69+51 = 128px = 16-tile window). Translated names verified <= 51px narrow (<= 56px normal).
_why src/pokenav_match_call_data.c:gText: Check-page flavor texts, printed like match_call_messages.h by pokenav_list.c PrintMatchCallFlavorText (FONT_NARROW, x=2, 16-tile window -> 126px narrow); normal cap = widest original flavor line (147px); narrow widths verified <= 126px.
_why src/data/text/follower_messages.h: Printed by data/scripts/follower.inc (EventScript_FollowerGeneric etc.: message 0x0 / waitbuttonpress) in the field message box = window 0, menu.c sStandardTextBox_WindowTemplates 27 tiles = 216px, text at x=0; 208 leaves room for the down arrow.
